Question Choices: Select. A histogram has most data on the left and a long tail to the right. Identify the shape : Symmetrical Left-tailed Right-tailed No-pattern
Solution: A long tail on the right -> right-tailed (right-skewed)

Question Choices: Select. What does "symmetrical" mean? : One-side-is-longer Both-sides-look-similar Only-one-peak Data-is-random
Solution: Symmetrical means both sides look like mirror images

Question Choices: What is an outlier? (A) Most common value   (B) A value far from others   (C) Middle value   (D) A group of values
Solution: An outlier is a value much higher or lower than the rest

Question Choices: What is a cluster? : (A) A single value   (B) A gap   (C) A group of data close together   (D) The largest value
Solution: A cluster is where many values are grouped together

Question Choices: Select. A graph has one value far away from all others. Identify the feature: Peak Cluster Outlier Symmetry
Solution: A value far from others is an outlier
